Let me analyze the workbook. The formulas are in rows 3-14, columns C through G. Each formula uses SUMIFS to sum data in rows 17-24 based on month criteria.

The pattern in most formulas: `SUMIFS(C$17:C$24,$B$17:$B$24,">="&$B3,...)`. The sum range is C$17:C$24 (absolute rows, relative column), criteria range $B$17:$B$24 (absolute), and date reference $B3 (absolute column, relative row).

Looking at row 4 (Feb), column D (INSP): `=IF(SUMIFS(D17:D24,B17:B24,">="&B4,B17:B24,"<="&EOMONTH(B4,0))=0,"",SUMIFS(D17:D24,B17:B24,">="&B4,B17:B24,"<="&EOMONTH(B4,0)))` - here D17:D24, B17:B24, B4 are all relative (no $). This is an error - should be D$17:D$24, $B$17:$B$24, $B4.

Row 13 (Nov), column G (CLS): `=IF(SUMIFS(G17:G24,B17:B24,">="&B13,B17:B24,"<="&EOMONTH(B13,0))=0,"",SUMIFS(G17:G24,B17:B24,">="&B13,B17:B24,"<="&EOMONTH(B13,0)))` - also relative. Error.

So there are exactly 2 reference type errors: D4 and G13.
